name: shipright
description: Ship your MVP fast, grow it right — the Project Brain OS for AI coding: a project constitution, 5 architecture boundaries and a quality gate, build-now-vs-defer judgment, fault tolerance, session state, and community-skill dispatch.

boundary_guard.title: Boundary guard
boundary_guard.description: Block the two highest-confidence boundary violations (a service importing the DB, a deep import into another module's internals) as Claude writes them. Fails open; does nothing outside module-structured projects. Off by default.
